narrative.intro: I thrive in fast-moving IT environments where network reliability, automation, and cybersecurity intersect. From leading ISO 27001:2022 ISMS implementation to enterprise SD-WAN rollouts and SOC mentorships, I pair hands-on engineering with disciplined incident response.

pillars.title: Operational Reliability
pillars.detail: Design and monitor LAN/WAN infrastructures, enforce HA, and ensure networks stay resilient during migrations.

pillars.title: Automation & DevOps
pillars.detail: Build CI/CD pipelines, containerize workloads, and script routine operations to reduce toil and standardize environments.

pillars.title: Security-First Mindset
pillars.detail: Respond to threats, harden systems, and drive ISMS programmes, SOC processes, and controls that surface actionable intelligence quickly.

experienceTimeline.title: DevOps Engineer/Information Security Officer
experienceTimeline.description: Lead DevOps operations and information security initiatives for payment processing systems.
highlights: Manage hybrid infrastructure combining on-premise and AWS cloud services
Administer VMware ESXi for production Linux servers with Tomcat and Nginx
Maintain multi-master Production MySQL database setup for high availability
Oversee Fortigate firewalls in HA and Cisco switches for secure connectivity
Deploy applications using AWS EC2, S3, VPC, Route 53, RDS, Load Balancing, WAF, and Lambda
Manage Windows servers including IIS and MSSQL
Monitor systems with Zabbix, Grafana, and Prometheus with proactive alerting
Ensure reliable WAN connectivity for office and production environments

experienceTimeline.title: Information Security Lead / ISO 27001 Implementation Lead
experienceTimeline.place: One Window Private Limited · Sociair CRM+ HRIS
experienceTimeline.description: Led end-to-end ISO 27001:2022 implementation for One Window Private Limited (Sociair CRM+ HRIS with omnichannel AI integration), overseeing the full ISMS lifecycle from gap assessment through Stage 1 and Stage 2 audits. Served as primary point of accountability across all ISMS controls, documentation, and audit coordination, culminating in successfully receiving official ISO 27001:2022 certification for Sociair.
highlights: 🏆 Breakthrough Achievement: Officially received ISO 27001:2022 Certification for Sociair SaaS platform
Spearheaded full-cycle ISO 27001:2022 implementation, from initial scoping and gap analysis through certification audit readiness
Owned the ISMS design and documentation across all 93 Annex A controls under the 2022 standard
Led Stage 1 (documentation review) and Stage 2 (on-site audit) with external certification body — completed both audits with zero major non-conformities
Coordinated cross-functional teams across product, engineering, HR, and operations to embed security controls into daily workflows
Established risk assessment and treatment processes, Statement of Applicability (SoA), and internal audit programme
Served as primary liaison between the organisation and the certifying body throughout the entire audit cycle

experienceTimeline.title: Network System Administrator
experienceTimeline.description: Dual role across multiple organizations — Ambition Guru Corporate and Ambition Guru College — managing distinct infrastructure environments simultaneously to ensure optimal network performance, reliability, and security.
highlights: Installed, configured, and maintained network infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, servers, and wireless networks.
Managed and troubleshooted firewalls: Fortinet 120G, Fortinet 70G, Sophos XG2100 / XS210, RG-NBR6215-E Ruijie Gateway Firewall.
Configured and maintained routers: RG-EG105G V2 Ruijie Router, Mikrotik RB760iGS (HEX S).
Worked with switches: Huawei CloudEngine S5735-S-V2 Series, S220-8P4S 8 Port POE Switch, Cloud Engine S5735-L24T4S-A1, Cisco CB350, Cisco SG350-28, Juniper EX2300T.
Managed wireless access points: Ruijie RAP62, RAP2260 Series (Indoor), Ruijie Outdoor AP, UniFi Indoor AP, Cambium cnPilot e400, Huawei AirEngine 5576-26.
Monitored network performance and responded quickly to outages to ensure uptime.
Configured laptops, desktops, printers, and shared office devices.
Coordinated with vendors for technical support and procurement.

projectShowcase.title: Unified Payment Gateway
projectShowcase.description: Architected, containerized, and deployed a high-availability merchant payment processing platform capable of handling secure transactional workflows. Integrated RESTful microservices built with Java Spring Framework and PostgreSQL, paired with a React and Next.js merchant dashboard, and backed by automated GitLab CI/CD pipelines, containerized runners, multi-stage Docker builds, and Zabbix telemetry on Ubuntu Server.
projectShowcase.highlight: Implemented automated multi-stage Docker builds and isolated containerized GitLab Runners to optimize image footprints, accelerate deployment workflows, and ensure 24/7 server monitoring.

projectShowcase.title: ISO 27001:2022 Certification — Sociair (One Window Pvt Ltd)
projectShowcase.description: End-to-end ISO 27001:2022 implementation and certification for One Window Private Limited (parent of Ambition Guru Pvt. Ltd.), scoped to Sociair — a CRM+ HRIS platform with omnichannel AI integration. Owned the full ISMS lifecycle from gap assessment and risk treatment through Stage 1 and Stage 2 audits, officially achieving ISO 27001:2022 certification.
projectShowcase.highlight: 🏆 Major Breakthrough: Officially received ISO 27001:2022 Certification for Sociair following Stage 1 and Stage 2 audits with zero major non-conformities identified.

projectShowcase.title: Automated Log Monitoring & Alerting
projectShowcase.description: Centralized Syslog collection with parsing, filtering, and Gmail SMTP email alerts for critical events.
projectShowcase.highlight: Boosted visibility into network/firewall activity with zero manual effort.

projectShowcase.title: ELK Stack Logging Lab
projectShowcase.description: Deployed Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana on Kali Linux to aggregate and visualize system telemetry.
projectShowcase.highlight: Enabled real-time monitoring dashboards that accelerated troubleshooting.

projectShowcase.title: Job Vacancy Web Scraper
projectShowcase.description: Automated daily scraping of vacancy portals and mailed Excel reports of new listings.
projectShowcase.highlight: Reduced manual search time by automating notifications for target roles.

projectShowcase.title: CI/CD Deployment & Monitoring Stack
projectShowcase.description: Automated deployment of Node.js and Laravel applications on AWS EC2 using Docker, Docker Compose, and Jenkins, with integrated Prometheus and Grafana for real-time monitoring and alerting.
projectShowcase.highlight: Achieved end-to-end automation and full observability with proactive alerts and zero manual monitoring.

projectShowcase.title: Enterprise Network Configuration & Automation
projectShowcase.description: Configured, deployed, and automated multi-vendor networks for banks, cooperatives, government offices, and private institutions. Implemented routing, switching, firewall policies, and wireless infrastructures tailored to client requirements.
projectShowcase.highlight: Delivered fully optimized and automated enterprise networks across diverse environments with high availability, security, and scalable wireless coverage.

projectShowcase.title: Automated API Regression Testing Tool
projectShowcase.description: Designed and developed an API testing platform similar to Postman with integrated CI/CD validation. Implemented functionality to store baseline API responses and automatically compare them with new responses during deployment.
projectShowcase.highlight: Built response comparison logic to detect unexpected API behavior changes and block faulty deployments. Developed a React-based interface for managing API collections and test cases.

projectShowcase.title: Multi-Tenant Learning Management System (LMS) – DevOps & Infrastructure
projectShowcase.description: Handled DevOps operations for a multi-tenant Learning Management System supporting guardian, student, and teacher services. Built CI/CD pipelines, containerized services, and managed asynchronous task processing and event-driven communication for scalable application operations.
projectShowcase.highlight: Automated application deployment and background task processing using Docker, GitLab CI/CD, Celery, and Kafka to support scalable multi-tenant LMS operations.
